title: Student Result Management System
description: A system to manage student results where admin can add marks, calculate grades, and generate result reports per semester.
steps: Design the DB schema — students, subjects, marks, and grades tables
Build the admin login page with session-based authentication
Create the marks entry form with subject-wise input fields
Write grade calculation logic based on percentage ranges (A, B, C, D, F)
Build the result view page with a clean printable layout
Test with sample data and handle edge cases like absent/zero marks

title: Library Management System
description: A desktop application to manage book inventory, issue/return tracking, and fine calculation for a library.
steps: Design DB schema — books, members, issued_books, fines tables
Build the member registration and search functionality
Implement book add, remove, and search features
Create the issue & return flow with date tracking
Write fine calculation logic for overdue returns
Test with realistic data and generate monthly reports

title: E-Commerce Website
description: A full-stack e-commerce platform with product listings, cart, checkout, and order management.
steps: Plan the app architecture — routes, DB models, and API structure
Build user auth with JWT — signup, login, and protected routes
Create product catalog APIs with MongoDB and connect to React frontend
Build the shopping cart with state management (Redux or Context API)
Integrate Stripe payment gateway and send order confirmation emails
Build the admin panel for product CRUD and order management
Deploy frontend on Vercel and backend on Render

title: Chat Application
description: A real-time chat app supporting private and group chats with message history and online status.
steps: Set up Node.js + Express backend and integrate Socket.IO
Design MongoDB schema — users, chat rooms, and messages collections
Build user auth with JWT and socket authentication middleware
Implement private messaging and group room join/leave events
Build the React chat UI — message bubbles, online status, typing indicator
Add message history with infinite scroll pagination
Deploy and test with multiple browser sessions simultaneously

title: Expense Tracker
description: A personal finance tracker to log daily expenses, categorize spending, and visualize monthly trends.
steps: Design the data model — expense categories, amounts, and dates
Build the add/edit/delete expense form in React with validation
Group and filter expenses by category and month
Integrate Recharts or Chart.js for monthly trend bar/pie charts
Add budget limit alerts with conditional color-coded warnings
Connect to Firebase Firestore or use LocalStorage for persistence

title: Online Quiz Platform
description: A platform where teachers create quizzes and students attempt them with scoring and leaderboard.
steps: Design DB schema — users, quizzes, questions, attempts, and scores
Build role-based auth — teacher and student accounts
Create the quiz builder for teachers — add questions, options, correct answers
Build the timed quiz attempt page with countdown timer in React
Implement auto-scoring and instant result display after submission
Add a per-quiz leaderboard and teacher analytics dashboard

title: Attendance Management System
description: A web app for faculty to mark and track student attendance subject-wise with monthly reports.
steps: Design DB schema — students, subjects, faculty, and attendance records
Build faculty login with role-based session management
Create attendance marking form — date-wise, subject-wise input grid
Calculate attendance percentage per student per subject
Add shortage alerts — highlight students below 75% in red
Build student-facing view to see their own attendance history

title: Food Delivery App
description: A mobile food delivery application like Zomato/Swiggy with restaurant listings, cart, and order tracking.
steps: Plan the architecture — user, restaurant, order, and delivery modules
Design MongoDB schema for restaurants, menus, orders, and delivery agents
Build restaurant listing with location-based search and filters
Implement cart, checkout flow, and Stripe payment integration
Add real-time order status tracking with Socket.IO events
Integrate Google Maps API for delivery agent live tracking
Add ratings, reviews system, and push notification support

title: Hospital Management System
description: A comprehensive system for managing patients, doctors, appointments, billing, and medical records.
steps: Design complex DB schema — patients, doctors, appointments, billing, medicines
Build multi-role auth — admin, doctor, receptionist, and patient roles
Implement patient registration and complete medical record management
Build appointment scheduling with conflict detection and availability slots
Create OPD/IPD management module with bed tracking
Add billing system with automated invoice PDF generation
Build medicine inventory with expiry tracking and low-stock alerts

title: Job Portal
description: A job board where companies post jobs and candidates apply with resume upload and tracking.
features: Job search with filters (location, salary, role)
steps: Design DB schema — companies, jobs, candidates, and applications
Build dual authentication — company accounts and candidate accounts
Create job posting interface with rich text description for companies
Build job search with filters — location, salary range, job type, skills
Implement resume PDF upload using Cloudinary and candidate profile builder
Add application tracking dashboard for candidates
Build company-side applicant management and admin moderation panel

title: Blog / Content Platform
description: A blogging platform where users can write, publish, and read articles with likes and comments.
steps: Set up Node.js + Express backend and MongoDB for posts, users, comments
Build user auth — signup, login, and editable profile page
Integrate a rich text editor (Quill or TipTap) for writing posts
Create publish, save as draft, and delete post functionality
Add likes, comments, and tag-based post categorization
Implement a user follow system and personalized feed

title: URL Shortener
description: A service to shorten long URLs with click tracking, expiry, and QR code generation.
features: Shorten any URL with custom alias
steps: Design DB schema — original URLs, short codes, click counts, and expiry
Generate short unique IDs using nanoid and store URL mappings
Build the redirect logic — short URL lookup and 301/302 redirect
Track click analytics — timestamp, device type, and browser info
Create an analytics dashboard with chart visualization per link
Add QR code generation using a QR library and URL expiry settings
